skill.name: hig-project-context
skill.description: Create or update a shared Apple design context file for HIG-focused AI workflows.
skill.summary: Builds a reusable Apple HIG project context document for design guidance across related skills.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Apple design reviews often repeat basic project questions. This skill creates a shared context file so HIG guidance can stay specific and consistent.
actual_capabilities: Checks for an existing .claude/apple-design-context.md file before asking new questions.
Guides discovery from README files, Xcode project files, Info.plist, assets, and source imports.
Captures product, platform, technology, design system, accessibility, and user context.
Provides a Markdown template for a reusable Apple design context document.
Defines an update flow that preserves unchanged context and edits changed sections.
limitations: It depends on accurate project files and user confirmation.
It does not validate designs against every Apple platform requirement.
It may need manual review for incomplete or outdated app metadata.
It does not replace accessibility testing on real devices.

use_cases.title: Prepare HIG Reviews
use_cases.description: Create baseline context for an iOS, macOS, or multi-platform app before asking for design guidance.

use_cases.title: Keep AI Guidance Aligned
use_cases.description: Store platform, framework, and accessibility details so Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can reuse them.

use_cases.title: Update Redesign Context
use_cases.description: Refresh shared context when product stage, target platforms, or design system choices change.

prompt_templates.title: Create a New Context File
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the hig-project-context skill to inspect this Apple app project and create .claude/apple-design-context.md. Ask me only for missing details.

prompt_templates.title: Update Existing Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the hig-project-context skill to review the existing Apple design context. Ask what changed, then update only affected sections.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for HIG Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the hig-project-context skill to summarize our platforms, technology stack, accessibility goals, and design system before other HIG skills run.

prompt_templates.title: Consolidate Multi-Platform Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the hig-project-context skill to build a context file for an app that targets iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS. Highlight unclear platform assumptions.

output_examples.input: Create context for a SwiftUI health app with iOS and watchOS targets.
output_examples.output: A Markdown project context document summarizing product purpose, target platforms, SwiftUI stack, HealthKit use, accessibility goals, and known design challenges.

output_examples.input: Update context after adding iPad support and custom brand colors.
output_examples.output: A revised context document that changes the platform table and design system notes while preserving unchanged product and accessibility details.

output_examples.input: Prepare context before running other HIG skills.
output_examples.output: A concise confirmed context summary plus questions about missing minimum OS versions and user personas.

best_practices: Confirm discovered project facts before using them for design recommendations.
Keep the context file current when platform targets or app stage changes.
Record accessibility goals with the same care as visual design choices.
anti_patterns: Do not assume missing platforms or OS versions without user confirmation.
Do not overwrite existing context sections that have not changed.
Do not use stale context when project files show newer information.

faq.question: What file does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates or updates .claude/apple-design-context.md for shared Apple design context.

faq.question: Does it read project files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect common Apple project files and then ask the user to confirm findings.

faq.question: Can it work with UIKit and SwiftUI?
faq.answer: Yes. The context template includes SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit, and mixed technology stacks.

faq.question: Does it replace a full HIG audit?
faq.answer: No. It prepares context that other HIG skills can use for more focused guidance.

faq.question: How does it handle existing context?
faq.answer: It checks for the existing context file, asks what changed, and preserves unchanged information.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use the output?
faq.answer: Yes. The output is a Markdown context file that these tools can read in later workflows.
